These five usually bring in more than everything else combined. Written by Elena Marín Founder and managing partner Published 22 September 2026 Reading time 2 min read Campaigns get the attention, but flows make the money. A flow is an email, or a short series, sent automatically when someone does something on your site. Once it’s built, it works every day without anyone pressing send. 1. Welcome Sent when someone joins your list. Three emails over a week: who you are, what you’re best at, and a reason to buy now. This is the flow people actually read. 2. Browse reminder Sent when a known visitor looks at a product and leaves. One email, a few hours later, with that product and two similar ones. No discount needed. 3.
